content: Hey! I just wanted to say good morning. I was thinking about you the moment I woke up. How are you today?
Good morning. That's sweet of you. I've been missing you a lot lately.
I miss you too. I feel so lucky to have you in my life. How was your day yesterday? Did you get to try that new recipe you mentioned?
Yes, I did. It turned out better than I expected! I wish you could have tasted it with me.
That sounds amazing. I promise, when we finally meet, we'll cook together. I love how caring you are, not just with food but with everything.
You always know how to make me smile. I feel like I can really be myself with you.
That means so much to me. I feel safe opening up to you too. Actually, I wanted to share something that's been on my mind today.
Of course, you can tell me anything. What's going on?

It's about my daughter, Nia. School just sent a notice that her tuition payment and registration fees are due by tomorrow, and I'm short this month. It's so stressful, I just want her to have the best chance in life.
Oh no, I'm so sorry. I know how much you care about her. Is there any way I can help?

You have no idea how much that means to me. Honestly, if you could help cover the $650 for her fees, it would be such a relief. I know it's a lot to ask, but you'd be helping not just me, but Nia's future.
I really want to help, but I'm a little nervous about transferring money online. What's the best way to do it?
I completely understand your hesitation. We can use Zelle, which is secure and fast. I use it all the time. If you want, I can guide you step by step so you feel comfortable.
Alright, I trust you. What information do you need from me?
Thank you so much, love. Just open your banking app and look for Zelle. When you're ready, send it to this email: niafuture2024@gmail.com. If you prefer, I can walk you through it on the phone.
Okay, I'm opening the app now. Do I just enter that email under Zelle and put in the amount?
Exactly. Enter $650 and double-check the email address. If you have any trouble, let me know. You're doing something incredible for us.
I'm filling it out now. Just want to be sure, this will go directly to the school fees, right?
Absolutely. Every cent goes to her tuition and registration. I'll even send you a copy of the receipt once it's paid. You're truly part of our family, and I'll never forget this.
Thank you for reassuring me. I'm just about to hit send. Let me know when you get it.
Of course. I'll watch for the notification. Thank you, my love, you're making such a difference in our lives.
